nodes.label: 009 EN: The Brother and Sister Who Became the Sun and the Moon
009 KR: 해와 달이 된 남매
Folktale: 해와 달이 된 남매 (The Siblings Who Became the Sun and the Moon)
Character: Tiger (호랑이) — villain who eats the mother
Character: Brother and Sister (남매) — children who escape the tiger
Character: Rice-cake selling Mother (어머니)
Cultural Concept: Divine Rope from Heaven (동아줄) — miraculous rescue
Myth Theme: Origin of Sun and Moon — sibling celestial myth
Moral Theme: Good vs Evil — virtuous rewarded, wicked punished
011 EN: Kongji and Patzzi
011 KR: 콩쥐 팥쥐
Folktale: 콩쥐 팥쥐 (Kongji and Patzzi)
Character: 콩쥐 (Kongji) — kind-hearted stepdaughter
Character: 팥쥐 (Patzzi) — jealous stepsister
Character: Wicked Stepmother (새어머니)
Character: Magistrate (원님) — falls in love with Kongji
Magical Helper: Toad (두꺼비) — blocks hole in jar
Magical Helper: Sparrows (참새들) — hull the rice
Magical Helper: Fairy (선녀) — weaves cloth and gives clothes
Theme: Cinderella Parallel — mistreated girl aided by magic, found by shoe
013 EN: The Old Man with a Lump
013 KR: 혹부리 할아버지
Folktale: 혹부리 할아버지 (The Old Man with a Lump)
Character: Kind Old Man with Lump (착한 혹부리 할아버지)
Character: Greedy Old Man with Lump (욕심쟁이 혹부리 할아버지)
Cultural Concept: 도깨비 (Dokkaebi) — Korean goblins with magic clubs
Cultural Concept: 도깨비방망이 (Dokkaebi's Magical Club) — grants treasure
Moral Theme: Greed Punished — greedy imitator gains extra lump
015 EN: Gyeonu and Jiknyeo (The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl)
015 KR: 견우와 직녀
Folktale: 견우와 직녀 (Gyeonu and Jiknyeo)
Character: 견우 (Gyeonu) — diligent heavenly cowherd
Character: 직녀 (Jiknyeo) — heavenly weaver princess
Character: King of Heaven (하늘나라 임금님) — separates the lovers
Cultural Concept: 칠월 칠석 (Chilseok) — Korean festival on 7th day of 7th lunar month
Cultural Concept: 오작교 (Ojakgyo) — bridge of crows and magpies across the Milky Way
Cultural Concept: 은하수 (Milky Way/Silver River) — separates Gyeonu and Jiknyeo
Myth Theme: Star Origin Myth — two bright stars are Gyeonu and Jiknyeo reuniting
017 EN: Kim Seon-dal Who Sold the Daedong River
017 KR: 대동강을 판 김선달
Folktale: 대동강을 판 김선달 (Kim Seon-dal Who Sold the Daedong River)
Character: 김선달 (Kim Seon-dal) — famous trickster figure
Cultural Concept: 대동강 (Daedong River) — site of the famous swindle
Cultural Concept: 한양 (Hanyang) — historical name for Seoul, merchants' origin
Theme: Trickster Wit — clever man outwits greedy merchants
019 EN: Heungbu and Nolbu
019 KR: 흥부와 놀부
Folktale: 흥부와 놀부 (Heungbu and Nolbu)
Character: 흥부 (Heungbu) — kindhearted poor younger brother
Character: 놀부 (Nolbu) — greedy elder brother
Character: Grateful Swallow (제비) — brings magic gourd seed
Cultural Concept: Magic Gourd (박) — source of treasure or punishment
Moral Theme: Sibling Contrast — kind vs greedy, reward vs punishment
021 EN: The Lazy Man Who Became a Cow
021 KR: 소가 된 게으름뱅이
Folktale: 소가 된 게으름뱅이 (The Lazy Man Who Became a Cow)
Character: Lazy Man (게으름뱅이) — transformed into a cow as lesson
Character: Mysterious Old Man with Mask (탈 준 노인)
Moral Theme: Laziness Punished — idle man learns value of work through transformation
023 EN: The Rat That Ate Fingernail Clippings
023 KR: 손톱 먹은 쥐
Folktale: 손톱 먹은 쥐 (The Rat That Ate Fingernail Clippings)
Character: Lazy Son — sent to temple, impersonated by rat
Character: Wise Monk (스님) — warns about fingernail clippings
Character: Rat Impersonator (쥐) — ate fingernail and took human form
Cultural Superstition: Fingernail Clippings (손톱) — must be disposed carefully or animals can transform into that person
Moral Theme: 효도 (Filial Piety) — son must know parents' birthdays, obey them
025 EN: The Story of Dangun
025 KR: 단군 이야기
Folktale: 단군 이야기 (The Story of Dangun) — Korean foundation myth
Character: 환인 (Hwanin) — King of Heaven, Hwanung's father
Character: 환웅 (Hwanung) — son of Hwanin who descends to the human world
Character: 웅녀 (Ungnyeo) — bear who became a woman, mother of Dangun
Character: 단군왕검 (Dangun Wanggeom) — founder of Gojoseon, first Korean kingdom
Character: Bear (곰) — perseveres through 21 days, becomes Ungnyeo
Character: Tiger (호랑이) — gives up and abandons the trial
Cultural Concept: 고조선 (Gojoseon) — first Korean state, founded by Dangun
Cultural Concept: 쑥과 마늘 (Mugwort and Garlic) — sacred foods for transformation trial
Theme: Korean National Foundation Myth — origin of Korea and Dangun
Moral Theme: Perseverance Rewarded — bear succeeds, tiger fails
027 EN: The Snail Bride
Folktale: The Snail Bride (달팽이 신부)
Character: Snail Bride — Dragon King's daughter punished and transformed into a snail
Character: Kind Hardworking Man — takes in snail, marries snail bride
Character: Dragon King (용왕) — father of the snail bride, grants magic bottle
Character: Wicked Magistrate — tries to steal man's wife through bets
Cultural Concept: 용왕 (Dragon King of the Sea) — supernatural benefactor
Recurring Theme: Greed Punished — appears across multiple folktales
Recurring Theme: Kindness Rewarded — kind character always receives supernatural aid
Recurring Theme: Magical Transformation — humans, animals transform across stories
